notes: Tier+Tactical's ammo system and gun scripts (raycasts and arm moves in tier-tactical-core), shared by every pack built on it (Support_TT_Ammo.cs, Support_TT_Raycasting.cs and Support_TT_Weapons.cs in Weapon_Package_Tier1). Its preferences the host rules read are server settings the host changes in the Admin menu's Add-On Settings: starting and most ammo of each type, bots' endless ammo, endless grenades, what dead players and bots drop, bots picking up ammo, ammo items used up when full, and the Light MG's slow walk. The others keep Kai's defaults: the T+T2 ammo system, recoil on, bullet slowdown on.

handles.Player::pickup: engine: magazines are kept per tool slot; a gun picked up brings the rounds it was thrown with, or comes full
handles.servercmdDropTool: engine: a thrown gun takes its own slot's rounds with it
handles.ItemData::onAdd: engine: the thrown gun lying in the world keeps those rounds for whoever picks it up
handles.Weapon::onUse: engine: drawing another copy of the gun in hand switches to that slot's rounds and shows them
handles.serverCmdUnUseTool: engine: the ammo display clears as the gun is put away
handles.gameConnection::onDeath: engine: the ammo display clears as the dead player's gun leaves the hand
handles.WeaponImage::onMount: engine: a gun new to its slot comes full and shows its ammo as it is drawn
handles.WeaponImage::onUnMount: engine: the ammo display clears as the gun leaves the hand
handles.servercmdLight: the magazine's light_states: the light key reloads in Ready, Empty and EmptyFire, else works the light
handles.onMissionEnded: nothing to free: the ammo types it deletes are the port's tables, read at import
handles.WeaponImage::TT_displayAmmo: engine ammo display: the ammo's name, rounds and reserve, up for 4 seconds on each change (display_ticks)
handles.WeaponImage::TT_decrementAmmo: engine: each shot takes its rounds from the slot's magazine
handles.WeaponImage::TT_canFire: the magazine checks' `shot` fact; a dead player's gun has left the hand
handles.WeaponImage::TT_onDeathCheck: the magazine check TT_onDeathCheck (ammo on); a dead player's gun has left the hand, so no reload plays
handles.WeaponImage::TT_onEmptyFire: the magazine's display_scripts: a dry pull shows the ammo, with no click
handles.TT_getActiveTool: engine: rounds are kept by the slot the gun was drawn from
handles.TT_initAmmo: the host rules' registered table holds each pack's ammo types
handles.call:TT_initAmmo: the host rules' registered table holds each pack's ammo types
handles.TT_registerAmmoType: the host rules' registered table reads each call
handles.TT_defaultIfUnset: never runs: it is the fallback for a server without RTB, and here the copy's RTB_registerPref calls are server settings
handles.call:TT_defaultIfUnset: never runs: it is the fallback for a server without RTB, and here the copy's RTB_registerPref calls are server settings
handles.TT_knockback: the shot's recoil push (the port's TT_knockback script rule)
handles.Player::TT_setSpeedMultiplier: engine: a projectile's `slow` scales the hit player's speed
handles.Player::TT_resetSpeed: engine: a projectile's `slow` wears off after its ticks
handles.Player::TT_slow: engine: a projectile's `slow`, from TT_dampenVelocity in its onCollision
handles.Player::pushDatablock: engine push_archetype: the type is laid over the holder's own, same shape only, health kept, never on the dead
handles.Player::popDatablock: engine pop_archetype: the type is lifted and the one beneath comes back
handles.Player::getFirstDatablock: engine: the holder's own type stays beneath every laid one
handles.Player::resetDatablock: engine: death lifts every laid type (no gun in these packs calls it)
handles.Player::playPain: engine: changing a player's type plays no pain sound
handles.ShapeBase::setDatablock: engine: a type set while others are laid on changes the one beneath
handles.Armor::onTrigger: engine image commands: jet with the gun in hand runs its onAltTrigger (the alt_images table)
handles.ItemData::TT_initAmmoPickup: the host rules' ammo_items table: each ammo item's TT_ammoPickup lines
handles.ShapeBase::pickup: engine: an ammo item the rules used up counts as picked up, so its spawn brick waits its respawn time
handles.bigstaticItem::onAdd: the host rules' ammo_items table: the pile's TT_ammoPickup lines
handles.TT_registerAmmoSet: its weapon and grenade sets only decide which types a dead player drops, by the drop preferences (the host rules' on_death and grenade_types)
handles.call:TT_registerAmmoSet: its weapon and grenade sets only decide which types a dead player drops, by the drop preferences (the host rules' on_death and grenade_types)

prefs.$Pref::Server::TT::Start*: a new life starts with that much of the pack's ammo type (on_spawn)
prefs.$Pref::Server::TT::Max*: ammo items and a dead player's bag fill the type up to it (on_pickup)
prefs.$Pref::Server::TT::BotInfAmmo: bots' weapon ammo never runs out (on_spawn)
prefs.$Pref::Server::TT::PlayerAmmoDrop: a dead player drops their weapon ammo in a bag (on_death)
prefs.$Pref::Server::TT::BotAmmoDrop: a dead bot drops its weapon ammo in a bag (on_death)
prefs.$Pref::Server::TT::PlayerNadeDrop: a dead player drops their grenades in the bag (on_death)
prefs.$Pref::Server::TT::BotNadeDrop: a dead bot drops its grenades in the bag (on_death)
prefs.$Pref::Server::TT::BotAmmoPickUp: bots pick up ammo items and bags (on_pickup)
prefs.$Pref::Server::TT::FullAmmoPickUp: an ammo item is used up even when it added nothing (on_pickup)
prefs.$Pref::Server::TT::LMGSlow: the Light MG lays its slow walk on as it fires only with it on (cmd_lay, from its onClick's guard)

$Pref::Server::TT::Ammo.how: the guns' magazines follow it (T+T2: reloads fill from the reserve; T+T1: endless reloads; Classic: nothing is used and there is no display; Arena: shots come from the reserve with no reloads; a gun that must reload keeps its magazine under Classic and Arena, its reloads free)

$Pref::Server::TT::AlwaysReloadEx.how: explosive single-shot guns (TT_alwaysReloadPref "Ex") keep loading under the Classic and Arena ammo systems (the Ammo System's magazine supply)

$Pref::Server::TT::AlwaysReloadNonEx.how: other single-shot guns (TT_alwaysReloadPref "NonEx") keep loading under the Classic and Arena ammo systems (the Ammo System's magazine supply)

$Pref::Server::TT::DisplayAmmo.how: off, the guns show no ammo display (their magazines' hide_display)

$Pref::Server::TT::DisplayTime.how: how many seconds the ammo display stays up (the magazines' display_ticks; 0 keeps it up)

$Pref::Server::TT::Recoil.how: off, the guns lose their recoil kick (their shots' kick)

$Pref::Server::TT::DisableBulletSlow.how: on, bullets no longer slow who they hit (their projectiles' slow)

$Pref::Server::TT::EasterEgg.how: on, the easter-egg weapons (Tier 1A's nailgun, Tier 2's scoped magnum, Tier 2A's match pistol, Explosive 2's mortar, the Retro Magnum, Classic Shotgun and the Browning, Scout, Semi-auto Battle and Compact rifles skins) are offered in item lists, from the next start; off they stay hidden, as the original did not load them

$Pref::Server::TT::DisplayNades.how: off, grenades show no count (their magazines' hide_display)

$Pref::Server::TT::MolNadeTargetBugfix.how: off, a molotov's fire burns only one player each time it sears, as the original's loop stopped at the first (the fire's aura max_targets); on, everyone in it

$Pref::Server::TT::MolNadeTeamkill.how: on, a molotov's fire sears its thrower's teammates and allies too, 1 each time instead of 4, in a mini-game with weapon damage on, friendly fire or not (the fire's aura ally_damage)

$Pref::Server::TT::RemountDups.how: on, drawing another copy of the gun in hand puts it away and draws it afresh, its draw sound and wait again (the magazines' remount); off, the gun stays up and takes that copy's rounds

$Pref::Server::TT::RemoveOnNoNades.how: on, a grenade's tool is taken from the inventory as its last grenade goes (the magazines' clear_when_out); off, the tool stays for more grenades to come
